For preferred shareholders, this approach converts their income component into additional equity, affecting the balance between current income and future capital value, and may influence investor perception of the company’s capital management priorities and financial flexibility.

data.title: America’s Car-Mart Extends Waivers Amid Strategic Review
data.description:
America’s Car-Mart ( (CRMT) ) has shared an announcement.

America’s Car-Mart, Inc. reported that its lenders, led by Silver Point Finance, LLC, have repeatedly extended temporary waivers of certain anticipated or existing events of default under its October 30, 2025 Credit and Guaranty Agreement. The Scheduled Termination Date for these waivers, initially set under a June 25, 2026 amendment and subsequently extended on September 4, 10, and 18, 2026, now runs through September 24, 2026 and includes temporary relief from minimum liquidity and collateral coverage requirements.

The company is concurrently conducting an evaluation of strategic alternatives through a board-appointed special committee, considering options such as financing, recapitalization, restructuring, and potential M&A transactions. Management notes that it has made progress in discussions with third parties and its lenders, but cautions that there is no assurance of securing permanent waivers, achieving a sustainable capital structure, or delivering a favorable outcome for stockholders given its past and anticipated covenant and reporting defaults.
